# DeepSeek Whale-chan Robot

> Aliases: OpenDafeiyu, DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘具身机器人. DeepSeek 大肥鱼 / 鲸鱼娘 / Dafeiyu / Whale-chan embodied character simulation in MuJoCo. Current source demo: VD2.4, Windows, 23 actuators, contact-aware small steps, turning, low hops, whale-tail coordination, expressions and RGB marker approach.

Source-run workflow; matching separately licensed character assets are installed by tools/install_character_assets.py from the AR2 runtime ZIP. The matching ZIP is distributed through the project GitHub Release. The installer downloads and verifies it automatically. No API key or LLM is needed for the demonstrated sequence. Code license: MIT; character/model/media terms are separate. Current capabilities are simulation. Current source adds optional DeepSeek text intents, contact walking, head gestures and feedback-driven behavior sequences with supported pause/resume. Voice input, learned locomotion and physical companionship remain planned.
